noncomputable def VTask.prev : {α : Type u_1} -> [DecidableEq α] -> (l : List α) -> (x : α) -> x ∈ l → α :=
fun α [hdec : DecidableEq α] l x hx =>
match l with
| [] => sorry -- This case should not happen due to the membership proof
| [_] => x
| y :: ys =>
  if hdec.eq_true (eq_of_mem_of_not_mem hx (not_mem_nil _)) then
    getLast ys
  else
    match VTask.prev ys x hx with
    | y' => y'
